title: unify-terraform-private-state-layout-refactor-gpu-iam-networking
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Refactors Terraform private state layout and unifies GPU node pool, IAM, and networking modules. Migration tool included. No user-facing API changes; infra teams must follow upgrade steps in README.
description: Background: Private deployments currently have multiple terraform state layouts across cloud modules (gpu node pools, iam bindings, networking). This divergence complicates upgrades and operator automation (redwood-private-installer) and caused a recent failed upgrade during a Dedicated -> Private rollout. This PR unifies the state layout and module boundaries for private deployments: - Consolidate GPU node pool resources into a single module with clear inputs for instance types, GPU counts, autoscaling, and taints. - Standardize IAM role and binding resources into a central iam module that exposes a minimal set of principal bindings and custom role definitions. - Normalize networking resources (VPC, subnets, route tables) into a networking module with stable names/ids that can be referenced from other modules. - Introduce a state migration helper script + terraform import guidance to move existing state into the new layout without re-provisioning. Motivation: Simpler upgrades, reduce mismatch surface area between installer and terraform state, and enable safe automated rollouts for on-prem and VPC installs. Checklist: - [x] Consolidate GPU node pool module - [x] Create central iam module - [x] Normalize networking module - [x] Add migration guide and helper - [x] Update README and examples - [x] Add unit and integration terraform validate checks Changes summary: - modules/gpu-node-pool/main.tf, variables.tf, outputs.tf (consolidated resources, added autoscaler optional block) - modules/iam/main.tf, roles.tf (wrapped custom roles, moved service accounts bindings) - modules/networking/main.tf (stable resource names; exported subnet ids) - modules/state-migration/README.md + scripts/migrate_state.sh - examples/private-gcp/ and examples/private-aws/ updated with new module inputs - root modules updated to call new module paths Migration notes: A migration helper script (scripts/migrate_state.sh) is included. Operators must run terraform init && terraform plan on the new layout and then run the migration helper to import existing resources into the new module addresses. See modules/state-migration/README.md for step-by-step. Testing: - Local terraform validate: passed for GCP and AWS example overlays - Integration tests: applied new layout to a non-production VPC in staging and verified no resource replacement for SAs and node pools (imports used) - CI: terraform fmt, validate, and custom plan-diff checks passed. Rollout plan: 1) Read migration README and run in staging 2) Coordinate with infra on maintenance window 3) Run migration helper to import state 4) Apply changes and monitor node pool autoscaler and networking connectivity 5) Backout: run state import on previous layout if immediate rollback needed Related: ENG-4821 (state layout consolidation), INF-309 (private installer follow-up).
